entities.summary: Filippo Emanuele Bottino was an Italian heavyweight weightlifter who won a gold medal at the 1920 Olympics. In 1922, he became the first Italian weightlifter to break a world record, in the press, and in 1924 he finished sixth at the Paris Olympics. He was made a Knight of the Italian Republic and received the Medal of Honour for Sporting Merit.
